visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide night shot of the Shibuya Crossing in Tokyo, featuring iconic bright neon billboards, several buses on the road, and crowds of people walking. Large text overlays dominate the center. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a steaming bowl of ramen on a wooden table; it features thin pink slices of beef, a soft-boiled egg, and green garnish. (3) Hands wearing black nitrile gloves are seen in a kitchen setting, carefully pouring a light-colored broth over noodles in a white bowl. (4) A spoon lifts a clear, golden broth from the ramen bowl to show its consistency. (5) Chopsticks lift a large, thin, marbled slice of pink wagyu beef, holding it up against the light to show the texture. (6) Another close-up shows pieces of dark, tender meat being lifted from the broth. (7) Noodles are lifted with chopsticks, dripping with soup. (8) Back in the kitchen, the chef in black gloves adds more toppings, including slices of wagyu and green onions, to the bowl. (9) A young woman with dark hair and a white bib is shown in a medium shot inside the restaurant; she takes a bite of the ramen and looks pleasantly surprised, giving a thumbs-up. (10) She is then seen pouring a yellow seasoning powder from a small glass jar into her spoon of soup. (11) The camera pans across the restaurant counter showing the chef working behind a wooden partition. (12) The final shot shows the exterior entrance of the ramen shop at night with a bright sign and menu displayed outside.
